brief:
Israeli Caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sought private talks with Palestinian party leader Mansour Abbas while publicly attacking Palestinian political organizations, Middle East Eye reported. Abbas said Netanyahu's speech condemning Palestinian parties placed him at personal risk, creating a contradiction between the prime minister's private diplomatic overtures and his public rhetoric.

Netanyahu's private engagement with Abbas occurred alongside his public denunciation of Palestinian political movements.

title: Netanyahu sought secret talks with Palestinian party leader despite vilifying him publicly
